findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V153 images: front, back and side still read as broad flared panels with only weak isolated ridges; the pleat rhythm is not clearly legible at product scale and the hem remains rigid.

The 60 mm thigh-shell cutback is present in the generated geometry, but crouch and sit still show broad, hard-edged upper-thigh panels at the front opening. This iteration did not resolve the shorts silhouette or demonstrate pose coverage.
Front, side, back and arm-cross views retain pinched triangular facets and abrupt surface transitions over the torso/hip/waist panels; these are visible garment geometry defects.
The prone render remains a collapsed overlap of limbs and garment panels, with the skirt presenting rigid lobes rather than a plausible drape. This required pose remains visually unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. V153 directly tests a shorter measured-body thigh shell but the crouch/sit renders still show broad hard-edged panels. Do not repeat a scalar hem adjustment. Next implement panel connectivity and fit-aware pose deformation for the skirt/shorts; separately remove torso/waist facets, then rebuild and directly inspect all eleven poses. Pleat appearance, fit, UV, material, Shape Key, Unity, VRChat, package and release remain unverified.
